# Meter Assignment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:MeterAssignment`](gmeow-MeterAssignment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/MeterAssignment>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)

A reified relator binding a carrier (e.g. a voice), a [`MetricStructure`](gmeow-MetricStructure.md), and a [`MusicalTimeSpan`](gmeow-MusicalTimeSpan.md). Consecutive assignments model bar-by-bar changes; concurrent assignments on different carriers over one shared [`TempoMap`](gmeow-TempoMap.md) model polymeter (stress case 14).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

Use [`gmeow:MeterAssignment`](gmeow-MeterAssignment.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
